badges.name: Precision Sniper
badges.description: Score 90% or higher in any completed quiz.

badges.name: Flawless Gladiator
badges.description: Get every answered question right in a quiz, with no skips.

badges.name: Week Conqueror
badges.description: Attempt questions from every regular week in this subject; Extras do not count.

badges.name: Comeback King
badges.description: Improve your score by at least 20 percentage points on a later attempt in the same mode and scope.

badges.name: Phoenix Rising
badges.description: Score 80% or higher in a Weak Questions drill.

badges.name: Speed Demon
badges.description: Score at least 90% while averaging 20 seconds or less per answered question.

badges.name: First Blood
badges.description: Answer 100 questions across your practice sessions. Repeat attempts count; skipped questions do not.

badges.name: Question Slayer
badges.description: Answer 200 questions across your practice sessions.

badges.name: Mind Gladiator
badges.description: Answer 300 questions across your practice sessions.

badges.name: Knowledge Dominator
badges.description: Answer 500 questions across your practice sessions.

badges.name: The Apex Overlord
badges.description: Answer 1,000 questions overall and correctly solve every question in every regular week of this subject. Extras are excluded.
